name: Fooocus
tagline: Streamlined local image generation interface focused on clean prompt results without complex node wiring.
real_test_summary: Tested generating images locally with minimal slider adjustments and built-in style presets. Produces consistent high-detail outputs offline with far less setup friction than complex node graphs.
pros: Simple, focused UI avoids overwhelming node graphs for everyday image generation
Runs offline with no subscriptions, image limits, or watermarks
Includes built-in refinement, inpainting, and style options
cons: Less granular custom workflow control than node-based tools like ComfyUI
